system.unidentifiedDesc: This medallion is strung on a chain and worn around the neck.
system.description:
This magical medallion is strung on a chain and worn around the neck. If the wearer concentrates for 1 round, he may read the thoughts of any one creature within 90'. The wearer may move normally but cannot fight or cast spells while concentrating.

The DM must roll [[/r 1d6 #Broadcast thoughts on 1.]] each time this item is used; it will not work properly on a roll of 1. If a 1 occurs, the medallion will broadcast the thoughts of the user to everyone within 90'! The DM may allow a saving throw vs. spells to prevent the medallion from reading a creature's thoughts.
